why_the_field_is_now_UNAVAILABLE: two attempts, two opposite failures, on one field, while the fields either side of it were right both times. The construction varies more than a positional rule can carry, and a third rule would be a guess presented as a measurement. OW-18 makes UNAVAILABLE a value, and this is what it is for.
lesson_recorded_against_myself: routing a field for ratification while ALSO publishing my own answer for it invited the reliance the routing existed to prevent. If a value is going to be ratified by someone else, publish the evidence and leave the value empty.
